headword: {院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}

definitions.explanation: The system in which a hospital issues a prescription and the patient has it filled at an independent pharmacy outside the facility. This is now the standard practice in Japan under the separation of prescribing and dispensing.

examples.japanese: この{病院|びょういん}は{院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}です。
{院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}の{場合|ばあい}、{処方箋|しょほうせん}を{持|も}って{薬局|やっきょく}へ{行|い}く。
examples.english: With out-of-hospital dispensing, you take the prescription to a pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}が{進|すす}み、{院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}が{一般的|いっぱんてき}になった。
examples.english: As the separation of prescribing and dispensing advanced, out-of-hospital dispensing became the norm.

notes:
The patient receives a prescription at the hospital and fills it at a separate {調剤|ちょうざい}{薬局|やっきょく} (dispensing pharmacy). Reflects {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}, the policy of separating prescribing from dispensing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {院外|いんがい}{処方箋|しょほうせん}: an outpatient prescription slip
- {院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}に{切|き}り{替|か}える: to switch to out-of-hospital dispensing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}: in-hospital dispensing — medicine is given out at the facility itself
